AI Oracle
Grade 8–12 · AI literacy

Understand AI before you lean on it.

AI Oracle is a nine-lesson course that explains what AI is and how chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini actually work, teaches the craft of a good prompt, and spends a whole unit on using AI honestly: academic integrity, checking what it tells you, and studying with it rather than letting it do the work.

Create a free account Sign in

Runs in any modern browser. Nothing to install.

What learners do

How it really works

Machine learning, neural networks and large language models explained without hype, with South African examples.

Prompting as a skill

The parts of a good prompt, the techniques that improve answers, and an interactive prompt builder.

Ethics that matter at school

Academic integrity, verifying AI answers, and using AI as a study partner, not a ghost-writer.

Reviews and progress

A review at the end of each unit, and progress that is saved as learners go.

What’s inside

Unit 1 · How AI Works

  • What is artificial intelligence?
  • Neural networks and training
  • Large language models

Unit 2 · The Art of Prompting

  • Anatomy of a good prompt
  • Prompt techniques
  • Build your own prompt

Unit 3 · AI Ethics in Education

  • AI and academic integrity
  • Verify, question, think
  • AI as your study partner

Questions

Do learners need an AI account to take the course?

No. Everything is explained and practised inside AI Oracle itself; nobody needs to sign up for ChatGPT or any other AI service.

Who is it for?

Learners from Grade 8 to 12, and it works well as a short unit before a school starts allowing AI for projects and research.

How much does it cost?

AI Oracle is one of thirteen tools on The Magic Lab. Start with a free account; full access to every tool is one plan, and schools can get a quote for all their learners and teachers.
